options.name: host
options.description: The name or IP address of the Cobbler system.

options.name: password
options.description: The password to log in to Cobbler.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to be used for REST connection. The default value depends on parameter O(use_ssl).

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: If V(false), an HTTP connection is used instead of the default HTTPS connection.

options.name: username
options.description: The username to log in to Cobbler.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to V(false) when used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
